# SCI-JINC v0.1 Numerical-Certificate Claim-Boundary Amendment r0.3

Status: incorporated into an implementation-blind Stage B author draft;
final Stage B acceptance and freeze remain pending

Prepared: `2026-08-29`

## Amendment

A passing exact owner-approved numerical-adequacy profile
`P_NA` and matching realization-bound certificate `E_p` establishes only
finite-precision fidelity to the exact selected discrete SCI-JINC oracle over
the pair's declared domain.

It does not establish:

- scientific adequacy of `s_a`, `a_a`, `b_a`, `c_a`, or `(r_max)_a`;
- adequacy of `n_sub` or square truncation;
- source-response or beam fidelity;
- photometric or astrometric performance;
- optimality;
- observational validation;
- response or covariance fidelity;
- readiness or production authority.

Qualification of a TolTEC parameter set remains a separate scientific and
observational program with its own objective, evidence, authority, and
lifecycle.

The existing denominator-separation rule and exact profile/certificate
requirements are unchanged. No exact owner-approved profile or matching
certificate is admitted or supplied by the SCI-JINC author packet. Therefore
finite-precision oracle fidelity and numerical near-cancellation support
remain typed unavailable in this author draft; they are not tested, failed,
achieved, or production-authorized.

This amendment is carried by the shared numerical-adequacy definition,
notation, assumption `SCI-JINC-ASM-007`, requirements
`SCI-JINC-REQ-023` and `SCI-JINC-REQ-042`, and prediction
`SCI-JINC-PRED-011` without changing their identifiers.
